THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Spicy Chicken Sandwich

Better than fast food — with control. Same Kirkland chicken fillets, two bun types, your choice of sauce. Adults get macro-friendly keto buns at 50 cal each. Kids get familiar sliders. No drive-through needed.

YIELD4 servings
TOTAL TIME15 min
COOK METHODAir fryer
EST. / SERVING~540 cal | ~50g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: Air fry at 400°F — don't microwave. Crispiness is the entire point.

Ingredients

PROTEIN

  • 4 Kirkland Signature Lightly Breaded Chicken Breast Fillets

Option 1

  • Slider buns (regular)
  • Ketchup (optional)

ADULT BUILD

  • 4 Bettergoods Keto Friendly Hamburger Buns (50 cal each)
  • Liquid Chipotle Sauce OR Money Mustard (~1/2 serving per sandwich)
  • Pickles (optional)
  • Shredded lettuce (optional)

Allergens: gluten, soy.

STOP. Chicken is cooked. Plate differently — adults get keto buns + sauce, kids get sliders.

Method

Shared base

  1. 1.COOK. Air fry chicken fillets at 400°F for 10-12 min until crispy and heated through.
  2. 2.TOAST BUNS. Lightly toast all buns in a pan, 30 seconds butter side down.

Adult — Spicy Keto Sandwich

  1. 3.BUILD. Sauce on bottom bun. Chicken fillet. Pickles + lettuce if using. Top bun. Serve 2 per plate.

Kid — Chicken Sliders · Option 1

  1. 3.PLATE. Cut fillet in half. Place on slider buns. Serve plain or with ketchup. Fruit or chips on side.

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult — Spicy Keto Sandwich: Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid — Chicken Sliders: Serve the kid portion as described above.

Keys to success

  • Toast the buns in a pan — 30 seconds, butter side down. Non-negotiable texture.
  • Sauce goes on the bun, not the chicken — prevents soggy bottom.

If something fails

Chicken isn't crispy: You microwaved it or overcrowded the air fryer. Single layer, 400°F, 10-12 min.

Sandwich is dry: You skipped the sauce. Even a half serving makes a huge difference. Also toast the bun — dry bun + dry chicken = bad.

Bun falls apart: The keto buns are softer. Toast them lightly and don't over-sauce.

Kids won't eat it: Split the fillet, use regular slider buns, serve plain or with ketchup. Don't force the spicy sauce.

Storage and reheating

Store: Cook fillets, store separate from buns. Assemble fresh.

Reheat: Air fryer 350°F 3-4 min to re-crisp. Don't microwave.

Lasts: Cooked fillets keep 3-4 days in fridge.

Estimated nutrition

~540 cal | ~50g protein.
